automation_evidence.quote: SELA, a neurosymbolic VLM agent framework that iteratively grounds primitives from signal visualizations

metric_evidence.quote: Results. As shown in Table 4, SELA consistently outperforms zero-shot and few-shot Numeric

evidence.quote: supervised baselines show no consistent advantage

practical_problems.note: Zero-shot setting targets scarce event annotations, but no label-budget sweep is run; supervised baselines are compared on one split
Tree-structured explanations are claimed; limitations state human evaluation of grounding faithfulness is not done; ELT ablation measures detection score only

summary: A VLM agent grounds natural-language event descriptions as an Event Logic Tree over signal primitives for zero-shot event detection; it beats zero/few-shot LLM baselines on the KITE benchmark and an ablation shows the logic structure matters.
